verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents grouping controls: you can change the error class, component, or stack trace, or send a custom fingerprint. That lets a developer force related errors into one group or separate wrongly collapsed ones, but only for future occurrences, and it is configured in code rather than as a triage action. Missing for 10: a UI or API action to merge existing issues, a UI or API action to split an existing grouped issue, and independent or hands-on corroboration of merge/split triage.
